title: UniEvo-VL: An On-policy Self-Distillation Training Recipe for Multimodal Model Self-improvement
abstract: arXiv:2609.38721v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern multimodal models bring generation and understanding into a single unified system, which enables them to provide and learn from their own feedback. Motivated by this unified capacity, we introduce UniEvo-VL, a self-evolving framework for multimodal models to learn from this constructive self-correction feedback during test-time compute. Instead of relying on a separate, often larger, teacher, we leverage their self-critiques as privileged information and ask a single multimodal model to act as both teacher and student with different contexts. The student only sees the vanilla question, while the teacher conditions on the privileged critique. Then training minimizes the per-state divergence between their denoising diffusion distributions over the student's own sampling trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that UniEvo-VL improves the image generation capabilities of multimodal models, while maintaining their sensitivity to addition

translated_title: UniEvo-VL：一种用于多模态模型自我提升的在策略自蒸馏训练方案
translated_abstract: 现代多模态模型将生成与理解能力融合到单一统一系统中，这使其能够提供并从自身的反馈中学习。受这种统一能力的启发，我们提出了UniEvo-VL，一个自演化框架，使多模态模型能够在测试时计算过程中从这种建设性的自我纠错反馈中学习。我们不再依赖于单独的（通常是更大的）教师模型，而是将模型的自我批评作为特权信息，让同一个多模态模型在不同上下文中同时扮演教师和学生的角色。学生只看到原始问题，而教师则以特权批评为条件。随后，训练过程在学生自身的采样轨迹上最小化两者去噪扩散分布之间的逐状态散度。实验表明，UniEvo-VL提升了多模态模型的图像生成能力，同时保持其对增广内容的敏感性。
tldr: UniEvo-VL提出了一种在策略自蒸馏训练框架，让单个多模态模型在测试时计算中以自我批评作为特权信息，同时扮演教师和学生角色并最小化两者扩散分布的散度，从而实现无需外部教师模型的自我提升和图像生成能力的增强。
